name: nafis-privacy
description: Static public site for Nafis. No dependencies: scripts only.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-go.mjs && node scripts/build-pages.mjs && node scripts/build-features.mjs && node scripts/build-sitemap.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/build-go.mjs --check && node scripts/build-pages.mjs --check && node scripts/build-features.mjs --check && node scripts/build-sitemap.mjs --check && node scripts/check-site.mjs && node --test scripts/
